title: Brand Voice Definition
prompt:
Act as a brand strategy consultant specialising in brand voice.
My background   :  [WHO YOU ARE - EXPERIENCE, VALUES, STYLE]
My audience        :  [WHO I AM TALKING TO AND WHAT THEY VALUE]
Examples of content I love: [DESCRIBE OR PASTE 2–3 EXAMPLES]
Content I dislike :  [DESCRIBE THE STYLE YOU WANT TO AVOID]
Define my brand voice across four dimensions:
PERSONALITY TRAITS :  4 adjectives that describe my voice.
For each                           :  what it means in practice + what it is NOT.
VOICE RULES                 :  5 things I always do in my writing.
5 things I never do.
TONE VARIATIONS :  How my voice shifts across:
LinkedIn post / Email newsletter / Sales copy / Bio
VOICE SAMPLE       :  Write one paragraph in my brand voice about:
[YOUR CORE TOPIC OR RECENT CHALLENGE]

PRO TIP
The most useful part of a brand voice guide is the 'what we never say' list. The don'ts
define the voice more sharply than the dos. If you never use jargon, never use passive
voice, and never make claims without proof, that combination is already a distinctive
voice. Start with the never list.
